title: OTA Announce v1
description: MQTT OTA notification metadata (docs/ota/11-ota-notification-mqtt.md). MQTT carries only metadata; the firmware binary is downloaded over HTTPS and verified by sha256 + RSA signature. 'signature' is the base64 RSA-2048 PKCS#1 v1.5 signature over the firmware sha256. In the lab the sha256/signature are structurally valid placeholders.

url.description: HTTPS firmware binary URL (GitHub Releases in production)

signature.description: base64 RSA signature over the sha256

min_version.description: Anti-rollback floor: device refuses if current < min_version
